title: FlexLine Repayment Term on a Past-Due Line
content:
When a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line is closed to new draws while a balance remains, months are added to the term over which the balance is repaid according to how late the line is on the closing date.

**How late the line is** means the days from the line's next due date to the closing date when an amount is past due.

- 20 days or more: 6 months are added.
- 1 to 19 days: 3 months are added.
- A line with no amount past due adds nothing.

Months added here count toward the term before any months are taken off it.

## Training questions

**A line with an amount past due is 19 days past its next due date on the closing date. How many months are added?** 3.

**And on day 20?** 6.

**The line's next due date has passed but its amount past due is 0.00?** Nothing is added; the count of days applies only while an amount is past due.

**How are the days counted?** In calendar days from the next due date to the closing date: a next due date of 1 April and a closing on 21 April give 20 days.
